Audit EVERY card on the **Nxeon board** to determine whether the feature it describes is ACTUALLY LIVE on production (https://nxeon.cloud + the obscured admin host). Read-only investigation — do NOT deploy, do NOT change code.

App: Nxeon platform, repo/code at /opt/nxeon on THIS box, live at nxeon.cloud. Admin panel only on the obscured host in NXEON_ADMIN_HOSTS (4j3d7gkr2wcbi34.nxeon.cloud). Board id = `cmsavdblr0008hla4pygic72o`.

## For each card (all columns — Review + Done especially):
Read its title + description + existing comments (Prisma: `db.card.findMany({ where:{ boardId:"cmsavdblr0008hla4pygic72o" }, include:{ column:true, comments:true } })`). Then determine, with EVIDENCE, one status:
- **LIVE** — the feature is on production now (verify: grep the code that implements it exists on `main`/HEAD, AND it's actually reachable/rendered on prod — curl the page, check the route/component, check a DB-backed feature returns data, etc.). Prod HEAD is deployed; confirm the implementing code is in the deployed commit.
- **STAGED / NOT DEPLOYED** — code exists/committed but not visibly live, OR needs a build/deploy/DB step.
- **RESEARCH / NO-CODE** — the card was answered as research/a decision in comments (e.g. "Ultahost", "Hostinger API", "Marketing Ideas") — not a shippable feature. Say so.
- **AWAITING NEXT PHASE / PARTIAL** — partially built, gated behind a flag, or explicitly deferred.
- **NOT BUILT** — no implementing code found.

Verify concretely — e.g.: "SEO" (blog/sitemap live?), "Broadcast" (Announcement model + admin→customer banner actually rendering?), "Client Info Beef Up" (/admin/users/[id] panel present?), "Traffic Monitor / Visitor Analytics" (/admin/visitors?), "Live chat", "Website Overhaul / v2" (is v9 the live homepage? are v2/v-drafts noindex?), "Backups", "Sitemap", "Resize>Upgrade", "Responsive Mobile Fix". Many were built in an earlier session — check whether they were actually deployed (git log, and reachable on prod).

## Output
1. Post a concise comment (authorName "Claude") ONLY on cards that are **NOT fully live** (STAGED/PARTIAL/NOT BUILT), stating the status + exactly what's needed to ship it. Don't comment on confirmed-LIVE cards or pure RESEARCH cards (to avoid noise).
2. Return a table: card | column | STATUS | one-line evidence | what's needed to go live (if anything). Group by status so the "not live" ones are obvious. Do not deploy anything.
